literal: character / he who is without / obtained / great wealth / good milk / vessel / by the impurity / having spoiled / like that
translation: The great wealth obtained by a man without good character is like pure milk that has spoiled due to the impurity of its vessel.
modern: நல்ல பண்பு இல்லாதவன் அடைந்த பெரிய செல்வமானது, பாத்திரத்தின் அழுக்கினால் அதில் ஊற்றி வைக்கப்பட்ட நல்ல பால் கெட்டுப்போவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares a person lacking good character to an unclean vessel. Just as pure, good milk turns sour and becomes useless when poured into a dirty pot, great wealth becomes spoiled and useless when it is held by a person without noble qualities. The word 'கலம்' (vessel) represents the person's character, while 'நன்பால்' (good milk) represents the wealth they acquire.
